LESSON: HILI NA HAYA

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.28: Hili na Haya

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Hili na Haya. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kusoma vifungu vinavyojumuisha tunda kwa kurejelea hili na haya kwa mfano: tunda matumizi ya hili na haya ili hili – matunda haya; embe hili – maembe haya n.k kujenga usomaji

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kusoma vifungu vinavyojumuisha tunda kwa kurejelea hili na haya kwa mfano: tunda matumizi ya hili na haya ili hili – matunda haya; embe hili – maembe haya n.k kujenga usomaji
   In simple words: practise until you can kusoma vifungu vinavyojumuisha tunda kwa kurejelea hili na haya kwa mfano: tunda matumizi ya hili na haya ili hili – matunda haya; embe hili – maembe haya n.k kujenga usomaji. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Hili na Haya using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Hili na Haya in the examples.
2. Explain Hili na Haya to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hili na Haya.
4. Show that you can: kusoma vifungu vinavyojumuisha tunda kwa kurejelea hili na haya kwa mfano: tunda matumizi ya hili na haya ili hili – matunda haya; embe hili – maembe haya n.k kujenga usomaji

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Hili na Haya using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hili na Haya important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kusoma vifungu vinavyojumuisha tunda kwa kurejelea hili na haya kwa mfano: tunda matumizi ya hili na haya ili hili – matunda haya; embe hili – maembe haya n.k kujenga usomaji

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
